resources.string: A screen saver with a cat in it. When the phone is charging and goes idle, Lili and a clock appear instead of a black screen.
Open the screen saver settings with the button below.
Set “When to start” to “While charging”. Many phones start out on “While docked”, and then she never appears.
Can’t find it? Search Settings for “screen saver” or “Daydream”. If your phone does not have it, use Preview: Lili stays on screen while it is open.
She does not appear on the lock screen itself, on the always-on display, or on battery. A touch sends her away. Between 23:00 and 07:00 she plays once, then sleeps and the screen dims.
